theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Λ : ℝ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), ‖L‖ ≤ Λ → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (S.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ L.toLinearMap) = 0 → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 1 → Real.sqrt ((((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • L).comp S.subtypeL).adjoint ∘L ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • L).comp S.subtypeL)).det) ≤ 1 + t ^ 2 / 2 * ∑ j : Fin P, (‖L (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) - S.starProjection (L (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (L (S.starProjection (L (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))))) + C * |t| ^ 3
